title: Disney+ Türkiye Creative Asset
description: Creative assets accepted by Disney+ for Turkish advertisers. Source: Disney Advertising 'Disney+ Video Commercial' spec, Türkçe edition (PDF, EMEA scope, dated 2025-01-29, © 2025) — the document Disney serves to Turkish-language buyers; there is no Turkey-specific media kit. Retrieved 2026-08-20. Only linear video commercials (pre-roll/mid-roll) are covered; interactive/pause/shoppable formats are unverified for Turkey and intentionally not accepted.

video.title: Video track
video.description: Exactly one video track, matching the audio duration; no duplicate frames; pull-downs added for broadcast removed; progressive via adaptive deinterlace with no frame blending.

frameRate.description: Native frame rate; duplicate frames not allowed.

colorSpace.description: Renk Alanı: YUV; cannot be unknown or None.

audio.title: Audio track
audio.description: Audio is required; exactly 1 track; 2-channel stereo; audio must match video duration.

disneyHosted.description: Availability table: Disney-Hosted: Evet on Desktop Web, Mobile Web, Apps and OTT.

verificationPixels.description: 1x1 doğrulama kodları from Disney+ approved vendors.

approvedVendorsOnly.description: Only from Disney+ onaylı sağlayıcılar (approved vendors).

market.description: Türkiye market; served by the Türkçe edition of the EMEA spec.

assetType.description: The only creative asset type with an official Disney+ spec for Turkish buyers.

durationSeconds.description: Süre: 5 - 120 saniye (range per the Türkçe edition).
durationSeconds.$comment: The Türkçe edition states '5 - 120 saniye'. The English and German EMEA editions instead list 15, 20, 30, or 60 seconds; which set actually services in Turkey is unverified (finding U5). This schema encodes the Türkçe edition's own wording.

placement.description: Pre-Roll ve Mid-Roll positions only per the spec.

clickableCTAStylingAllowed.description: Clickable-looking CTA buttons ('Daha Fazla Bilgi Al' / 'Şimdi Satın Al') not allowed.

audienceLevel.description: URLs/hashtags/QR codes/social handles accepted for 18+ profiles only; not for 17 & under.

safetyZoneTopRightPx.description: Keep the top-right 220x135 px of 1920x1080 clear; overlaps the player 'Ad' logo and countdown.

leadersAllowed.description: Lider slaytlar ve geri sayımlar kabul edilmez (no leader slates or countdowns).

letterboxing.description: Letterbox ve siyah çubuklar kabul edilmez (letterboxing and black bars not accepted).
letterboxing.$comment: The English EMEA edition permits letterboxing/pillarboxing on a case-by-case basis; the Türkçe edition rejects it outright (finding U5-adjacent divergence).

turnaroundBusinessDays.description: Yayın başlangıcından 5 iş günü önce teslim edilmelidir (deliver 5 business days before air date).
